mapper.sql: SELECT eval_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, eval_period, eval_date, delivery_score, delivery_weight, delivery_item_score, quality_score, quality_weight, quality_item_score, price_score, price_weight, price_item_score, service_score, service_weight, service_item_score, total_score, eval_level, status, audit_by, audit_time, audit_remark, evaluator_id, evaluator_name, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_supplier_eval
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_supplier_eval ( supplier_id, supplier_name, eval_period, eval_date, delivery_score, delivery_weight, delivery_item_score, quality_score, quality_weight, quality_item_score, price_score, price_weight, price_item_score, service_score, service_weight, service_item_score, total_score, eval_level, status, audit_by, audit_time, audit_remark, evaluator_id, evaluator_name, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{evalPeriod}, #{evalDate}, #{deliveryScore}, #{deliveryWeight}, #{deliveryItemScore}, #{qualityScore}, #{qualityWeight}, #{qualityItemScore}, #{priceScore}, #{priceWeight}, #{priceItemScore}, #{serviceScore}, #{serviceWeight}, #{serviceItemScore}, #{totalScore}, #{evalLevel}, #{status}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditRemark}, #{evaluatorId}, #{evaluatorName}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
